name: TernaryCognitiveAI

engines.julia: TernaryCognitiveAI cognitive reasoner: concepts, hypotheses, intentional output, formal cognitive ops (Julia-owned; do not reimplement in Python)
engines.python: LumenMAX ternary sequence substrate: state dynamics, discrete credit, GUI/dataset studio, file IO (Python-owned; do not reimplement in Julia)
engines.tritier: TriTier three-tier memory & execution subsystem: Persistent Storage (Tier P) -> System RAM & 50/50 Scheduler (Tier 2) -> Hot GPU VRAM bounded < 500MB (Tier 1)

ecosystem.principle: Julia + Python + TriTier = one unified ecosystem; each layer owns its strengths; shared contract + bridge eliminate language and hardware boundaries
ecosystem.bridge: tcai_bridge.py routes ask/teach/audit; tritier_adapter.py coordinates memory tiering and supercharged credit assignment; shared/contract.json is the single response shape

invariants: Unsolicited repetition is REPETITIVE (punish); requested repetition is REQUESTED_REPETITION (reward)
Generation must terminate via EOS, loop ban, margin abstain, or max_tokens
